sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: US steel and copper demand, driven by infrastructure spending and reshoring, will keep lifting NUE, STLD, and FCX, creating a durable bid for global metal prices that Indonesian exporters can ride.
Indonesia's downstream nickel and coal sectors face structural pressure from oversupply and weak Chinese offtake, making only cost-competitive, export-oriented producers viable long-term.
The IDR's persistent depreciation against the USD structurally favors Indonesian miners with dollar revenues and local costs, widening margins independent of commodity price swings.

Favor FCX-linked copper exposure and NUE/STLD steel proxies for US infrastructure pull; hedge IDR weakness by rotating into dollar-earning miners. Trim losers before the next Fed-driven risk-off leg.

themes: Indonesia's energy-transition policy is shifting toward gas and geothermal bridging fuels, structurally favoring integrated players like ESSA and TPIA over pure solar developers.

Global supply-chain reshoring for solar and battery components is creating durable margin tailwinds for US manufacturers, while Indonesian nickel-linked names face pricing pressure from LFP adoption.
sectors.ai: Buy selective laggards with proven cash flow: ESSA and TPIA remain the cleanest Indonesia exposure, while US names like VST and RUN offer liquid upside on rate-cut repricing. sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Mid-cap FMCG names are decoupling from large-cap staples as foreign flows rotate into higher-beta, domestically-exposed consumer plays with clearer earnings catalysts.

Retail and distribution-driven FMCG sub-sectors are seeing structural tailwinds from expanding rural digital payment adoption and cold-chain logistics penetration in tier-2/3 Java and Sumatra.
sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap consumer names with confirmed volume spikes (SSMS, BWPT) into Q3 earnings, but avoid chasing one-day limit-ups (BTEK, GZCO) lacking fundamental catalysts. Rotate toward staples with pricing power and export exposure (SSMS, FLMC) as IDX liquidity normalizes; trim names with weak cash conversion. Target 8-12% alpha over 4-6 weeks via momentum confirmation on pullbacks.
